_meta.purpose: Starter labeled semantic evaluation set for scripts/eval_interpreter.py -- the plan's 'real model (cannot be skipped)' test gate. This is a STARTER set (not yet the full >=60 reviewed cases the plan calls for) covering all six directive types, all three official paraphrase variants from Problem Statement Sec. 11.4, percentage/fraction wording (both directions), a capacity-relative reserve, distractors, and one negation case. Expand toward >=60 (more per-type coverage, more paraphrase variety, more boundary times) before treating this as the final release gate -- and freeze labels before running, per the plan, so repeated runs don't turn this into a set the prompt gets tuned against.
